recount.definition:
n. an additional (usually a second) count; especially of the votes in a close election
v. count again
recount.translation:
vt. 详述, 叙述, 重新计算
n. 重新计算

recountal.translation: n. 详细叙说, 详述

recounted.definition:
v narrate or give a detailed account of
v count again
recounted.translation: v. 详细叙述某事, 讲述某事( recount的过去式和过去分词 ); 重新计算

recounting.definition:
n an act of narration
v narrate or give a detailed account of
v count again
recounting.translation: v. 详细叙述某事, 讲述某事( recount的现在分词 ); 重新计算

recounts.definition:
n an additional (usually a second) count; especially of the votes in a close election
v narrate or give a detailed account of
v count again
recounts.translation:
n. 重数, 重新计算选票( recount的名词复数 )
v. 详细叙述某事, 讲述某事( recount的第三人称单数 ); 重新计算

recoup.definition: v. reimburse or compensate (someone), as for a loss
recoup.translation:
vt. 偿还, 赔偿, 补偿, 扣除
vi. 补偿损失

recoup oneself.translation: [经] 开支补偿, 回收费用, 回收损失

recoupable.translation: a. 可补偿的；可扣除的

recouped.definition:
v reimburse or compensate (someone), as for a loss
v regain or make up for
v retain and refrain from disbursing; of payments
recouped.translation: v. 重获（所失的东西）( recoup的过去式和过去分词 ); 补偿, 偿还

recouping.definition:
v reimburse or compensate (someone), as for a loss
v regain or make up for
v retain and refrain from disbursing; of payments
recouping.translation: v. 重获（所失的东西）( recoup的现在分词 ); 补偿, 偿还

recoupment.translation: [经] 赔偿, 补偿, 偿还

recoups.definition:
v reimburse or compensate (someone), as for a loss
v regain or make up for
v retain and refrain from disbursing; of payments
recoups.translation: v. 重获（所失的东西）( recoup的第三人称单数 ); 补偿, 偿还

recourse.definition:
n. act of turning to for assistance
n. something or someone turned to for assistance or security
recourse.translation:
n. 求援, 求助, 追索权
[经] 追索权

recourse account.translation: [经] 索赔帐户, 追索帐户(科目)

recourse claim.translation: [经] 行使票据上的追索权

recourse factoring.translation: [经] 有追索权的应收帐款转让

recourse for non-payment.translation: [经] 对拒绝付款的追索权

recourse fund.translation: [经] 偿还基金, 追索基金

recourse repudiation.translation: [经] 拒绝偿还债务, 否定追索权

recourse to set-off.translation: [经] 要求抵销债务的诉讼

recourses.definition:
plural of recourse
n. act of turning to for assistance
n. something or someone turned to for assistance or security
recourses.translation:
